direct_dependency_scope.reason: P2: previously unchecked 50 changed-destination callsites (22 distinct targets), plus 54 changed-encoding callsites with unchanged destinations (48 distinct targets).
direct_dependency_scope.anchor_method: Search each recorded exact byte anchor uniquely in each entire AP; recover target relative to the anchor, never from a blanket relocation. Tiny repeated bodies may use explicitly marked contextual anchors.
direct_dependency_scope.limits: Targets of the added layer are NOT recursively proven. Each unmapped direct branch in this layer is enumerated as UNVERIFIED_TRANSITIVE_DEPENDENCY, including branches with unchanged encodings. Indirect calls, literal-referenced data/function semantics and unprobed native paths remain outside a whole-program equivalence claim. Unexpanded direct branches of the original 122 bodies with unchanged instruction encodings are likewise enumerated; matching branch encodings alone does not establish target semantic equivalence.
direct_dependency_scope.decision: All 70 previously unmapped targets of changed-encoding branches are independently located and mapping-checked. Local full-body structure is verified for 69; assertion target 0xc9195aa has entry-block-only coverage. Existing algorithm/native-probe compatibility remains bounded evidence, not proof of every downstream behavior.
direct_dependency_scope.validation: Every decoded direct branch is checked against a known mapping or an exact, explicitly UNVERIFIED boundary record; original changed-encoding branches may not use that boundary exception. Added proofs have unique whole-AP byte anchors plus body hashes/instruction comparison; a mapping without code evidence is rejected.
